note: A pipeline, not a conversational agent, and the first adapter with two model origins in one run. Chat reads OPENAI_BASE_URL (three openai.OpenAI() call sites) and OPENAI_API_BASE (langchain's default embedding path). The embedding half reads INDEXRAG_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL and may point at a different provider entirely, so it is redirected through /forward/ rather than to a bare /v1 — an upstream map keyed by wire dialect cannot express two origins of the same dialect. No ANTHROPIC_*: every stage speaks OpenAI. 'command' here is the test's argv; a bare `orca record indexrag -- --data-dir …` launches python against a driver written into ctx.runDir instead.
